fact: TechCabal reports that Turbine, based in Port Louis, has accelerated more than 150 startups since 2016, running pre-incubation, one-year incubation and six-month acceleration phases for its cohorts.

CAJ News reports Mauritius inaugurated an AI Innovation Lab in Ebene Cybercity with STEMpower, with a 24-computer AI training lab and an electronics lab open to students, technology entrepreneurs, experts and civil society, and no startup programme or cohort stated.
The article says Mauritius's innovation initiatives include fab labs and an AI Tech Park, oriented towards innovation actors, citing the Blueprint for Mauritius 2025.

MRIC says its government-initiated National SME Incubator Scheme, operational since December 2017, works with 6 accredited private-sector incubators running pre-incubation, incubation and acceleration phases, with 50 start-ups produced and 65 ongoing projects as of October 2024.

La Turbine, ER Group's incubator founded in 2016, ran its 2026 Innovation Challenge, a two-month programme launched 17 September 2026 with seven selected start-ups, and says it has helped create 35 start-ups since inception.

La Plage Factory says six incubators are currently operating in Mauritius and over 350 companies have been through incubation, and its current Growth & Innovation incubation cohort runs with MRIC NSIS support and Punch by MCB sponsorship.

fact: Turbine, an incubator, says it is welcoming ten Mauritian start-ups into its incubation programme, eight from the 2025 Innovation Challenge, with structured support over several months.
COMFWB's National Women Entrepreneur Council opened a new incubation centre in Mauritius offering mentoring, coaching and workshops, with no cohort programme stated.
The Bank of Mauritius launched its Innovation Hub, Innov8, with a co-working space, a sandbox and access to mentors, and the release names no incubation or acceleration programme or startup cohort.
